title: Karnataka: Pvt school managements, staff protest for OPS, filling vacant posts

ai.summary: Private school management boards and staff in Karnataka protested for operational policy changes and filling vacant posts, demanding indefinite closure of private educational institutions from November 18.

facts.claim: The committee has called for indefinite closure of private educational institutions from November 18.
